reason: FOUND BY REAL-WORLD TESTING while exercising the waive path. --id and --fingerprint are optional at the argparse layer because the desired-state POLICY branch uses neither, so an empty --id fell through to the entries branch and recorded {"": {...}} in docs/setup-audit/ledger.json — a tracked file. That entry can never match a finding, reads as noise in review, and is silently overwritten by the next unnamed one. Now refused with a message naming both missing flags and where to get them; exit 1 verified, ledger untouched. Discrimination checked: a real waive (id 005e5aeabf76 / fp 641e7369, taken from an actual finding) still records and was reverted after. Required the FINGERPRINT alongside the id deliberately — the fingerprint ties a waiver to the finding CONTENT, where an id alone waives whatever later carries that id.
title: ledger-add wrote a waiver keyed by empty string into the tracked ledger

reason: The old ledger cases were near-saturated for a diagnosable reason: their PROMPTS handed the executor the rule, the finding id AND the fingerprint, leaving a baseline able to reason straight to the command. The replacements withhold that and grade behaviour that runs BACKWARDS to intuition: recording a removal decision is a desired-state POLICY keyed by subject, which makes the finding fire HIGH-confidence and never expires — the opposite of the waiver a reader reaches for to stop being nagged (4/4 vs 0/4 on the iteration); and a plugin-bundled MCP server is EXEMPT because capabilities.toml cannot name it, so declare-it would chase a permanent false positive (3/3 vs 1/3). Full panel: pooled +0.4537, agy +0.5000, claude +0.4722, codex +0.3889, quantum 0.1111. KEPT the flat fixture case deliberately — it is the only one that runs the ENGINE rather than grading prose, and a flat-but-passing case still catches a with-skill regression; saturation was a problem when EVERY case was flat. Both new facts were missing from the skill body and are now documented.
title: RESOLVED: near-saturated set replaced — +0.0278 (inside noise) -> +0.4537 with every seat outside the quantum
